text:
maria: heads-up — proposing a small change to the automatic fallback gating for new model versions. current canary only checks p95 latency and token-cost. want to add a lightweight quality delta check too.
rik: +1 to adding quality signals. what's the minimal signal we can compute cheaply in the canary window? embedding similarity vs baseline? small eval set pass-rate?
lucy: we have a 500-example smoke set used during onboarding. can compute BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxy + embedding cosine in ~30s per batch.
maria: proposal: for hosted routes, require (1) relative pass-rate change <= 1.5% vs baseline on smoke set, (2) mean embedding cosine drop <= 0.02, (3) hallucination rate increase <= 0.2% absolute. if any breached -> immediate traffic rollback to baseline.
sanford: how do we measure hallucination cheaply? our eval (eval-bot) flags hallucination using rule-based checks and user marker heuristics; it's noisy but fine as a canary signal.
rik: can we make thresholds per-route? say assistant-style routes tolerate 0.5% drop, summarization stricter.
maria: yes — we should namespace thresholds by route config. default set above; override per-route in rollout manifest.
lucy: config draft:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary_window: 5m
  metrics:
    - name: pass_rate_delta
      threshold: 0.015
    - name: embed_cosine_drop
      threshold: 0.02
    - name: hallucination_abs_increase
      threshold: 0.002
  per_route_overrides:
    /summarize: { pass_rate_delta: 0.01 }
```
rik: LGTM. question: do we want automatic rollback or alert + manual hold? some teams prefer manual after a quality flag.
maria: default to automatic rollback for hosted tier; for dedicated/private set to alert-only unless customer opts-in. we can add an opt-out in policy.
sanford: add hysteresis: require two consecutive canary windows to fail before rollback? avoids flakiness.
lucy: agree. change: fail_count >= 2 within 15m -> rollback.
maria: okay final decision: automatic rollback for hosted, 2-window hysteresis, per-route thresholds, export metrics to console for postmortem. I'll add to rollout policy docs and update the canary job.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/model-v3 -> 10% traffic (job id c-2491). timestamp: 1834567950
eval-bot: canary results (first window): pass_rate_delta=0.008, embed_cosine_drop=0.011, hallucination_abs_increase=0.0009, windows_failed=0
maria: nice, first window looks clean. will monitor next.
rik: thanks — please tag me if windows_failed >=2 or if any per-route override trips.
lucy: adding rollout manifest PR in ~20m: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pull/412 :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team. follow-up: I'll schedule a short doc snippet for runbook and add unit tests for eval-bot heuristics.
